title: Stability of a concept vector across fine-tuning checkpoints (replicate on open instruction-tuned variants)

original_idea.body: Extract a refusal/honesty vector from a base model and measure cosine similarity and steering effectiveness when applied to the official instruct version and a community fine-tune, using off-the-shelf checkpoints as a model-update proxy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: silent drift of safety vectors across fine-tunes degrades deployed defenses.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Off-the-shelf checkpoints, zero training; extraction + cosine/efficacy. Accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped (vector drift across checkpoints) with clear metrics.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Lifecycle maintainability labs rarely publish, public checkpoints.

novelty.reasoning: Stability a stated open problem; off-the-shelf-fine-tune proxy may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: This concept-vector drift proxy may be open.
